test_corrections: The first observer publication test draft used queue.queue for the admin producer recovery postcondition; the existing producer schema is queue.items (the HTTP API uses queue). Corrected before final green and reran the fixed baseline with the final hash 0b68949bc1d64bcbf8360acd71eb640712d2e05ca4a80ae011e86f3f7af4866c. Initial hash 65caaeee8d17b7627440fefdb1bb7fa2ab1ad27b5a8b31e9917f16125ed204bb is not final evidence. All six final old-publisher failures occur at substantive lost-publication assertions.
verified_boundaries: Real --report-only runs from an external cwd with complete config, real parser/reports/SQLite, no key/star/GPU/extension/process call; default/custom DB bytes and sidecars remain unchanged. Missing DB parents are not created; incompatible DB schema is not bootstrapped.

Configuration-only update_report discovers queued/failed/completed/archived catalog rows with empty inbox, keeps existing four-state pipeline accounting, ignores malformed legacy archived-index caches, and fails closed on malformed stage catalog.

Catalog schema and rows are read in a read-only transaction; all connections close before values are consumed. Missing/malformed/repeated-join identities and link redirection are rejected. Individual agreement conflicts remain UNKNOWN without dropping healthy rows. Existing FSM pipeline counts are not redefined as evidence counts.

Real admin producer and GET /api/queue show pending/in-progress/failed/completed evaluation task states correctly even when training metrics say COMPLETED. A durable evaluation-only retry remains visible with its configuration after the Lake closes and inbox empties.

Default report snapshots do not select, measure or parse the large configuration column. Opt-in persistent admin config is capped in SQL and during YAML/JSON conversion; config availability does not determine lifecycle state.

Malformed diagnostic-only metrics and generic non-dictionary backbone metadata no longer block actual queue publication/API delivery; legitimate failure alerts and original artifact bytes remain preserved.

Report JSON/Markdown and admin cache publishers read back exact output bytes; a silently lost write is not acknowledged. Missing/stale-output fault cases preserve prior bytes and recover after the injected fault is removed; unchanged reports keep timestamp/mtime.

Nested/external result roots retain the loader's default results-parent .orze/control-root pairing and pass the actual benchmark path guard. Relative custom DB paths are anchored to the selected config directory; explicit subcommands retain priority and conflicting global action flags are rejected.
limits: See docs/observer-catalog.md and docs/report-authority.md. V1-01 and V1 as a whole remain open; this is the report-only/catalog/admin-queue reader slice.
Pipeline audited counts, agreed task status, and qualified ranking are distinct. Historical missing stage rows remain unrecorded; they are not manufactured as successful stage receipts.

Per-row qualification and per-file publication readback do not provide a globally atomic filesystem/database view, a multi-file publication transaction, immutable observations, historical progress, or stale-attempt fencing.
Admin still serves a derived cache with the existing TTL. This item does not establish real-time status or migrate every other admin endpoint, verifier, director, or convergence consumer.
Full catalog reads remain O(task count). Persistent configuration budgets are per-item, not a whole-catalog memory cap. These display constraints do not bound all inbox/parser/prompt ingestion paths.
Default .orze/inbox/DB locations remain results-parent based as in the existing loader; report-only does not relocate an existing authority or rewrite normal runtime CLI path semantics.

Report and admin output files are authorized derived writes. The global atomic_write behavior outside these verified observer wrappers is unchanged; a failed later output does not roll back earlier published files.

No actual GPU/evaluator subprocess, paid provider, production license activation, package publication, deployment, live campaign mutation, or research-efficiency claim. Pro regression bypasses only the license boundary inside its test process.
